items.author: CTVNews.ca Staff
items.summary: Amid a churning trade dispute, the Trump administration faces a major test. What does it mean for Canada? Follow for live updates.
items.body: In a sweeping upset to U.S. President Donald Trump’s power in Washington, the Democrats have retaken control of the American legislative branch. Democrats won control of the Senate and Congress, in a widespread rebuke of Trump and the Republican Party, The Associated Press reported. Two years deep into a trade war, Canadians wait to see the impacts of the shift in the balance of power, but on Wednesday it remained unclear how the results will impact trade negotiations. The two sides have yet to come to an agreement, and while Prime Minister Mark Carney indicated progress, political watchers say immediate relief is unlikely. Nov 4 : Chinese genetic sequencing firm Novogene sued the Pentagon late Tuesday in U.S. District Court in Washington over its inclusion on a US list of companies allegedly aiding Beijing's military.
In June, the Defense Department added Novogene, Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba internet search provider Baidu and automakers BYD and NIO and others to its list of "Chinese military companies" that prohibits the Defense Department from contracting directly with the firms.

items.title: U.S. futures sharply higher after Democratic route in midterm elections
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: U.S. stock futures surged Wednesday after the U.S. midterm election yielded Democratic majorities in both houses of Congress. Investors parsed the potential impact on artificial intelligence, the ...
items.body: NEW YORK — U.S. stocks are surging Wednesday after U.S. President Donald Trump’s party lost its sole control of Washington in the midterm elections. Stocks generally do well in the months following any midterm U.S. election, regardless of who wins, and the S&P 500 soared 1.8 per cent toward its best day in three months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 1,112 points, or 2.1 per cent, as of 10 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 2.4 per cent higher. Stocks of solar-power companies helped lead the way as Wall Street tried to sort the winners and losers from the widespread losses for Republicans. Investors, meanwhile, see risks ahead for Trump’s social-media company, the artificial-intelligence industry and businesses owned by Elon Musk, who donated heavily to Republicans. Strategists along Wall Street had been urging investors not to get swept up in the election because it may not matter much for the broad market in the long term. Prices for stocks depend more on where profits for companies and interest rates are heading than on who controls what in Washington. “Earnings trump elections,” according to Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management. Still, Wall Street may have gotten a preferred political scenario as Democrats are set to take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives. That could counterbalance Trump’s White House, and Wall Street generally prefers split control of Washington because it lessens the risk of transformative changes to the economy. Much remains impossible to predict, of course, and Trump retains executive authority over key areas such as defense, foreign policy and in some instances trade. A downbeat forecast could be that “Trump is not now a lame duck, but an angry duck” who might restart tensions over tariffs and NATO allies’ levels of military spending, said Carsten Brzeski, global chief of macro at ING Bank. An optimistic view, Brzeski said, is that Trump becomes “a tame duck ... that he will slow down any disruptive efforts and that he will put more focus on trying to win the Nobel Peace Prize by ending the two big wars without big disruption, and on trade, nothing happens but a few words.” Here’s a look at some of the moves rippling through financial markets: Trump Media and Tesla are down Trump’s social-media company, Trump Media & Technology Group, was one of the market’s bigger losers following the election and dropped 9.5 per cent. It had already come into the day with a loss of 55.1 per cent for the year so far as Trump’s approval ratings had weakened. Since briefly touching a peak of US$175 five years ago, it’s dropped toward US$5. Its main business is Truth Social, which is most well known for Trump’s postings on the platform. Elon Musk’s businesses also struggled. Tesla fell 3.6 per cent, and SpaceX sank 3 per cent. Musk, a former top Trump adviser, is among the possible targets for investigations by a Democratic-controlled Congress. AI companies in general are under pressure Trump has been a big backer of the AI industry, and Democratic control of Capitol Hill could mean more regulation or restrictions for the industry. Concerns have grown across political parties about AI in general. Investors see Democratic victories in Texas in particular as possibly slowing the buildout of further AI data centers. Nvidia, the chip company that quickly became the poster child of the frenzy around AI-related stocks, slipped 0.5 per cent after falling as much as 2.8 per cent earlier in the morning. CoreWeave, a company that rents out access to AI chips to customers over the loud, fell 6.8 per cent Advanced Micro Devices, another chip giant, held up better. It rose 3.4 per cent after reporting much stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Green power companies are up Democratic control of Congress could light the way for companies in the solar and wind industries. First Solar jumped 11.1 per cent, and Enphase Energy climbed 11.6 per cent. Bond yields are down In the bond market, Treasury yields eased. That could be a signal that investors see less risk of Washington piling even more debt onto its already big mountain. Treasury yields had surged through the summer and reached their highest levels in decades because of worries about the U.S. government’s big debt, along with higher inflation and other concerns. A Congress controlled by Democrats could provide a check against more spending and cuts to taxes that would widen Washington’s deficit. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.92 per cent from 4.95 per cent late Tuesday. Stocks rally in much of the world Indexes climbed across most of the world. Stocks jumped 2.2 per cent in Paris, 2.2 per cent in Shanghai and 1.8 per cent in London. Japan’s Nikkei 225 was an outlier and fell 1.4 per cent. Stocks worldwide got a boost from easing oil prices. Brent crude, the international standard, dropped 2.9 per cent to US$100.63 amid continued uncertainty about what the war with Iran will mean for the global energy industry. The price for the most actively traded contract in the Brent market has been veering between roughly US$70 and US$120 per barrel since just before the war with Iran began. ___ Stan Choe and David Mchugh, The Associated Press AP Writer Elaine Lai contributed to this report from Hong Kong, and McHugh contributed from Frankfurt, Germany.

items.title: HUL proposes raising annual pay cap for non-executive directors to ₹15 cr
items.author: Sharleen Dsouza
items.summary: Hindustan Unilever has proposed raising the annual remuneration ceiling for non-executive directors from ₹4 crore to ₹15 crore, or 1 per cent of net profit, whichever is lower ...
items.body: Hindustan Unilever Ltd (HUL) has proposed increasing the annual aggregate remuneration limit for its non-executive directors to ₹15 crore or 1 per cent of the company's net profit, whichever is lower, for a five-year period starting April 1, 2026, the consumer goods major said in a stock exchange filing. The proposal, which will be placed before shareholders for approval through a postal ballot, represents an increase from the existing annual limit of ₹4 crore. The current remuneration ceiling was revised from ₹3 crore to ₹4 crore at the company's 91st annual general meeting in June 2024. According to the company's stock exchange filing, the proposed revised limit will remain in effect until March 31, 2031. The remuneration will be calculated in accordance with Section 198 of the Companies Act, 2013. Shareholders whose names appear in the company's register of members or list of beneficial owners as of November 6, 2026, will be eligible to vote on the resolution. The company’s board has appointed company secretary S N Ananthasubramanian as the scrutiniser for the postal ballot process.

items.title: アングル：米中間選挙の民主勝利、市場に新たな波乱　外交・財政リスク警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dhara Ranasinghe　Ankur Banerjee

[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Dhara Ranasinghe　Ankur Banerjee

[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] - 米中間選挙での民主党の圧勝は、市場にとって新たな波乱要因となった。市場は既に、イラン戦争の余波に加え、成長とインフレを押し上げてきたＡＩ（人工知能）ブーム、そして米国の債務拡大への対応に追われている。

投資家は市場の変動が続くとみて身構えている。特に２つの分野に注目が集まっている。今年に入り原油価格を７０％押し上げてきたイラン戦争の行方と、米国の財政支出を巡る激しい論争だ。

約６０００億ドルの資産を運用するＲＢＣブルーベイ・アセット・マネジメントのマーケット戦略責任者マイク・ベル氏は「市場にとって最大の潜在的な影響は、中間選挙という障害がなくなった今、トランプ大統領が中東でのエスカレーションに踏み切ると決断した場合だろう。エスカレーションが続きエネルギー価格が上昇すれば、株式と債券が同時に打撃を受ける可能性がある」と語った。

イラン戦争が続く中、原油価格は１バレル＝１００ドルを超える水準で高止まりし、消費者や企業の燃料コストを押し上げている。一方、中央銀行は、より大幅な利上げを迫られるような広範な物価急騰への波及リスクに警戒を強めている。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、５年以上にわたってインフレ目標を達成できていない。ユーロ圏でも、１０月のインフレ率はエネルギー高を背景に４％と３年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。今後数カ月でさらに上がる見通しだ。これにより、１２月の欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の利上げを巡る市場の観測が改めて裏付けられた。

アナリストによると、トランプ氏が外交政策の主導権を握り続けるため、地政学的リスクは引き続き高いという。

イラン戦争に加え、今年は、米国によるベネズエラのマドゥロ大統領の拘束や、デンマーク自治領グリーンランドを巡ってトランプ氏が欧州の同盟国に関税で脅しをかけたことも、投資家の不意を突いた。

ベレンベルクのチーフエコノミスト、ホルガー・シュミーディング氏は「トランプ政権の残り２年間は、外交政策を巡る大きな混乱に備えなければならないだろう」と述べた。

＜ＡＩ投資から債務へ＞

民主党の勝利を受けて規制面での監視強化がＡＩ分野の急成長を妨げかねないとの懸念が、市場の当面の焦点となった。

世論調査では、民主党支持者がＡＩへの規制強化を支持していることが示されており、投資家は民主党が多数派を占める議会が同分野への監視を強めると予想している。

プリンシパル・アセット・マネジメントのチーフグローバルストラテジスト、シーマ・シャー氏は「ＡＩは米国の成長ストーリーの極めて重要な部分を占めている。だから、どの政党が政権を握ろうとも、投資の拡大を支えつつコスト面の懸念に配慮するという、両方のいいとこ取りを目指すだろう」と述べた。同氏は、第２次世界大戦終結以降、Ｓ＆Ｐ株価指数が中間選挙の１年後にはいずれの場合も上昇していると指摘した。

それでも投資家は、市場の底堅さについて神経質になってきている。ＡＩの設備投資急増と多額の債務を抱える政府が、金利を数十年ぶりの高水準に押し上げ、市場の弱点を露呈させてきた。

シャー氏は、選挙結果を受けて一段と制約を受ける可能性がある財政政策の行方を注視すると付け加えた。

アナリストからは、共和党が勝利した場合に米成人に５０００ドルの小切手を配るというトランプ氏の公約が実現しないことへの安堵が示された。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルの新興国リサーチ世界責任者フェニックス・カレン氏は、民主党が議会を支配すれば、財政政策への監視が強まり、トランプ氏が支出拡大の面でできることに歯止めがかかる公算が大きいと指摘。「それは財政政策により厳しい制約を課すものであり、米国債利回りへの圧力を幾分和らげる助けになるはずだ」と語った。

４０兆ドルを超える米国の債務残高への懸念は、今年の国債利回りを押し上げる一因となってきた。

議会は２０２７会計年度の支出を巡る激しい論争を中間選挙後に先送りしており、資金調達合意に達するための期限を１２月１１日に設定した。

債務上限引き上げの期限は２０２７年後半まで到来しない見通しだが、民主党はいわゆる「Ｘデート」を、支出・税制政策を巡る共和党との交渉の切り札として使える可能性がある。借り入れ上限への対応に向けた賛成票と引き換えに、譲歩を迫るものだ。

シャー氏は「市場の変動は続くとみている。今後１年は手に汗握る展開になるだろう」と述べた。

ベレンベルクのチーフエコノミスト、ホルガー・シュミーディング氏は「トランプ政権の残り２年間は、外交政策を巡る大きな混乱に備えなければならないだろう」と述べた。

＜ＡＩ投資から債務へ＞

民主党の勝利を受けて規制面での監視強化がＡＩ分野の急成長を妨げかねないとの懸念が、市場の当面の焦点となった。

世論調査では、民主党支持者がＡＩへの規制強化を支持していることが示されており、投資家は民主党が多数派を占める議会が同分野への監視を強めると予想している。

プリンシパル・アセット・マネジメントのチーフグローバルストラテジスト、シーマ・シャー氏は「ＡＩは米国の成長ストーリーの極めて重要な部分を占めている。だから、どの政党が政権を握ろうとも、投資の拡大を支えつつコスト面の懸念に配慮するという、両方のいいとこ取りを目指すだろう」と述べた。同氏は、第２次世界大戦終結以降、Ｓ＆Ｐ株価指数が中間選挙の１年後にはいずれの場合も上昇していると指摘した。

それでも投資家は、市場の底堅さについて神経質になってきている。ＡＩの設備投資急増と多額の債務を抱える政府が、金利を数十年ぶりの高水準に押し上げ、市場の弱点を露呈させてきた。

シャー氏は、選挙結果を受けて一段と制約を受ける可能性がある財政政策の行方を注視すると付け加えた。

アナリストからは、共和党が勝利した場合に米成人に５０００ドルの小切手を配るというトランプ氏の公約が実現しないことへの安堵が示された。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルの新興国リサーチ世界責任者フェニックス・カレン氏は、民主党が議会を支配すれば、財政政策への監視が強まり、トランプ氏が支出拡大の面でできることに歯止めがかかる公算が大きいと指摘。「それは財政政策により厳しい制約を課すものであり、米国債利回りへの圧力を幾分和らげる助けになるはずだ」と語った。

４０兆ドルを超える米国の債務残高への懸念は、今年の国債利回りを押し上げる一因となってきた。

議会は２０２７会計年度の支出を巡る激しい論争を中間選挙後に先送りしており、資金調達合意に達するための期限を１２月１１日に設定した。

債務上限引き上げの期限は２０２７年後半まで到来しない見通しだが、民主党はいわゆる「Ｘデート」を、支出・税制政策を巡る共和党との交渉の切り札として使える可能性がある。借り入れ上限への対応に向けた賛成票と引き換えに、譲歩を迫るものだ。

シャー氏は「市場の変動は続くとみている。今後１年は手に汗握る展開になるだろう」と述べた。

items.title: El dólar registra su mayor caída en dos meses: así reaccionan las monedas de América Latina
items.author: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
items.summary: La victoria demócrata en el Congreso estadounidense presiona al dólar y favorece a las divisas latinoamericanas. Los inversionistas revisan sus expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, el crecimiento ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El dólar cae este miércoles tras la victoria del Partido Demócrata en las elecciones legislativas de Estados Unidos, mientras la mayoría de las monedas latinoamericanas gana terreno, encabezadas por el peso chileno, el colombiano y el mexicano. Ver más: Precio del oro tiene su mayor alza desde agosto tras victoria demócrata en EE.UU.: las razones del repunte La pérdida de fuerza de la divisa estadounidense responde a las expectativas de un mayor bloqueo político en Washington y posibles restricciones al desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, uno de los principales motores de inversión en Estados Unidos. El índice Bloomberg Dollar Spot retrocede 0,4%, después de alcanzar una caída intradiaria de 0,5%, su mayor descenso en dos meses. El resultado electoral amenaza con interrumpir la recuperación que acumulaba la moneda desde septiembre. David Forrester, estratega sénior de Crédit Agricole CIB en Singapur, sostuvo que “el talón de Aquiles del dólar estadounidense está quedando al descubierto”, ante su dependencia del auge de la inteligencia artificial. El peso chileno encabeza las ganancias regionales, seguido del peso colombiano y el mexicano. La depreciación del dólar favorece a ocho de las doce monedas incluidas en el ranking de Bloomberg , mientras otras cuatro registran pérdidas. A las 10:10 a. m., hora de Nueva York, asi estaba el desempeño: → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. En México, Felipe Barragán, analista de Pepperstone, atribuye la recuperación del peso a una reevaluación de las consecuencias comerciales del resultado electoral y a los diferenciales de tasas de interés que mantienen el atractivo de la moneda. El especialista destaca que las expectativas de crecimiento mexicano mejoraron, con una revisión de la proyección del PIB de 2026 desde 1,40% hasta 1,61%. La próxima decisión del Banco de México será determinante para las perspectivas monetarias. En Chile, Ignacio Mieres, Head of Research de XTB, destaca que el dólar alcanzó su menor nivel desde mediados de octubre, aunque la volatilidad del cobre continúa como un factor relevante para el mercado cambiario. El analista estima un rango de fluctuación de entre CLP$965 y CLP$975 por dólar. A su vez, Pepperstone destaca que Hacienda aumentará sus ventas semanales de divisas hasta aproximadamente US$1.000 millones durante noviembre. En Perú, Kambista atribuye la presión sobre el dólar al resultado electoral estadounidense y destaca que la evolución de los metales también influye en el mercado cambiario. Brasil enfrenta presiones fiscales propias. Barragán advierte que las expectativas de mayor inflación y tasas de interés elevan los costos de financiamiento y las primas de riesgo, pese al avance del real frente al dólar durante la jornada. Ver más: Dow Jones se dispara y el S&P 500 sube tras disiparse la incertidumbre electoral, mientras el dólar cae En Colombia, el peso también aprovecha la debilidad estadounidense, aunque persisten riesgos fiscales y monetarios. Pepperstone identifica los precios energéticos y la percepción de riesgo soberano como variables relevantes para la moneda. Chris Turner, analista de ING, considera que el resultado electoral podría anticipar riesgos para 2027, aunque la fortaleza económica estadounidense y la posibilidad de nuevas alzas de tasas de la Reserva Federal todavía respaldan al dólar. El estratega advirtió que “no perseguiríamos una caída adicional del dólar hoy por lo que, después de todo, podría ser una historia de 2027”, ante la posibilidad de que el mercado vuelva a concentrarse en los fundamentos monetarios. David Scutt, analista de mercado de Forex.com, también vincula la depreciación del dólar con las preocupaciones sobre una regulación más estricta de la inteligencia artificial y sus efectos sobre las acciones tecnológicas y los rendimientos del Tesoro. La atención de los inversionistas se concentrará ahora en los planes de financiamiento del Tesoro estadounidense, los próximos datos de empleo y las decisiones de política monetaria, factores que podrían modificar la trayectoria de las divisas.

items.title: Bono Único Familiar de noviembre 2026: fecha, monto y otros detalles del pago
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: ¿Cuándo pagarán el Bono Único Familiar de noviembre? Esto es lo que se sabe sobre el próximo depósito del Sistema Patria de Venezuela.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El Sistema Patria se prepara para iniciar la entrega del Bono Único Familiar correspondiente a noviembre de 2026, beneficio de distribución mensual dirigido a los jefes y jefas de hogar en Venezuela registrados en la plataforma. Ver más: ¿Bajará la inflación en Venezuela en 2027? Nuevo acuerdo entre el BCV y el gobierno la llevaría a dos dígitos Hasta este miércoles 4 de noviembre aún no se ha confirmado una fecha oficial, aunque medios informativos gestionados por terceros (no oficiales) prevén que la asignación se realice de manera progresiva durante los próximos días. El monto del mes tampoco ha sido anunciado por el Gobierno venezolano. Como referencia, en octubre el pago fue de 13.050 bolívares —equivalentes a US$14,97 al tipo de cambio del Banco Central de Venezuela (BCV)—, lo que representó un incremento de 8,07% respecto a septiembre, cuando se acreditaron 12.075 bolívares. El ajuste se explica porque se trata de un bono indexado y de pago mensual, según destacó el Blog del Patria. Con ese antecedente, para noviembre se estima que el beneficio podría ubicarse cerca o por encima de los 13.343 bolívares, unos US$14,93. En cuanto al calendario, el pago de octubre comenzó el lunes 5 de ese mes y se extendió hasta el 12, de forma directa y gradual. Por ese antecedente, se mantiene la expectativa de que la asignación de noviembre se concrete entre esta semana y la próxima, como ha ocurrido en períodos anteriores. Los beneficiarios podrán confirmar si recibieron el bono mediante un mensaje de texto enviado desde el número corto 3532, así como en la aplicación VeMonedero. El Bono Único Familiar reúne en un solo pago distintos programas sociales, entre ellos Hogares de la Patria, Parto Humanizado y José Gregorio Hernández. El beneficio llega a unos 6 millones de familias en todo el país. De confirmarse la proyección, el bono sigue lejos de cubrir el costo de vida de los hogares venezolanos. Los US$14,97 pagados en octubre equivalen a cerca del 2% del costo de la canasta alimentaria de septiembre, que según el Centro de Documentación y Análisis Social de la Federación Venezolana de Maestros (Cendas-FVM) se ubicó en US$761,35 (631.923,22 bolívares). Ver más: Clase baja, media y alta: los ingresos que definen a cada segmento en estos 10 países de Latinoamérica Si se suma el consumo de agua potable, estimado en US$13,49, el costo integral asciende a US$774,84 mensuales para garantizar la subsistencia. Además del Bono Único Familiar, por lo pronto, no hay anuncios oficiales sobre otros pagos que generan expectativa entre trabajadores y beneficiarios, como aguinaldos, beneficios navideños de la Plataforma Patria o ajustes trimestrales vinculados al comportamiento del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB).

items.title: Iranian officials gloat as US voters deal blow to Trump
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said in a written statement that US hostility would persist regardless of which party was in power.

Iranian officials gloat as US voters deal blow to Trump

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said in a written statement that US hostility would persist regardless of which party was in power.

Women gather next to an anti-US mural, showing the Statue of Liberty with a severed arm, during the 47th anniversary of the US expulsion from Iran, in Tehran, Nov 4, 2026. (Photo: West Asia News Agency via REUTERS/ Majid Asgaripour)

IRAN: Iran's government savoured the stinging rebuke delivered to Donald Trump in the midterm elections, declaring voters had rejected the war launched by the US president even as Tehran remained on high alert for the possibility of renewed strikes.
"Conscience or the cost of living, Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message," Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Iran's chief negotiator, posted on X on Wednesday (Nov 4), adding that Washington should not ignore public opinion by attacking his country again.
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said in a written statement that US hostility would persist regardless of which party was in power, warning against "even the slightest inclination towards submission" to the US .
"The US sees the end of its hegemony as distant; we see it as near," he added.

Democrats captured majorities in both the Senate and Ho us e in Tuesday's election , with victories in Republican strongholds underscoring deep fr us tration with Trump 's stewardship of the economy and his decision to launch a war that drove up gas prices.
In Iran, a news outlet run by the judiciary shared a joke circulating on X that " Trump failed at regime change in Iran but he succeeded in Texas", a reference to the southern state where a Democrat won a Senate race for the first time in decades.
But two senior Iranian sources told Reuters that while Iranian leaders welcomed the Democrats’ victory, Tehran was concerned that Trump could seek to compensate for it with a military strike, and remained on high alert.
Iran's leaders have long regarded the United States as their main enemy, referring to it as "the Great Satan".
At a state-organised rally on Wednesday commemorating the student takeover of the US embassy in Tehran during the 1979 Islamic revolution, demonstrators voiced triumph at an election they linked to Iran's success in surviving months of US attacks.
"The fact that the might of these warmongering Republicans has been broken, something unprecedented in human history, means that from now on we will see the real war unfolding inside the US Senate and among American officials ," said one, giving only his family name of Nazari.

Pictures of US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, on a dartboard during the 47th anniversary of the US expulsion from Iran, in Tehran, Nov 4, 2026. (Photo: West Asia News Agency via REUTERS/Majid Asgaripour)

Mediators have intensified efforts to end the war amid fears it could reignite after the election , with Trump on Tuesday declining to rule out a resumption of combat operations after the vote and Iran planning wider retaliation if war resumes.
The US and Israel attacked Iran on Feb 28, and Iran responded with strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases. Conflict also erupted in Lebanon between Iran-backed Hezbollah and Israel, and more recently spread to Yemen, from where the Iran-aligned Houthis have struck energy facilities, airports and other targets in Saudi Arabia.
Global oil and gas prices have shot up with shipping through the Strait of Hormuz severely disrupted after Tehran declared it closed, while the US has imposed a naval blockade on Iran, hitting Iran's economy hard.
"IRAN'S SHADOW OVER US ELECTIONS" Ahead of the US election, senior Iranian officials told Reuters that Tehran was deliberately prolonging talks with the US to weaken Trump politically ahead of the vote.
Some news outlets played on the timing of the election on the anniversary of the embassy seizure, when radical students cemented Iran's toppling of the US -backed Shah by storming the embassy and holding 52 Americans hostage there for 444 days.
Major Iranian newspaper Hamshahri linked the events with a front-page image showing Trump blindfolded with his head bowed.
With a headline declaring "Iran's shadow over US elections", it said Washington had been "47 years Iran's captive: from the capture of the spies' nest ( US embassy) to the November 2026 US Congress elections".
The Iran war has been unpopular among Americans since it began, and blaming the war for driving up costs was a foc us of the Democrats' election campaign.
Khamenei's message signalled that Tehran had no intention of showing flexibility on its demands for lasting control over the Strait of Hormuz or conditions to end the conflict.
"The consequences of ( US ) miscalculations and arrogant del us ions have manifested as a heavy burden of costs, borne by the American people and the puppet regimes subservient to the US government," he said.
Trump has offered shifting goals and timelines for the war that is now in its ninth month.
"I think a part of it was Iran, but at the same time people understood the importance of what I've done with Iran," Trump told Fox News, referring to the election result.
The conservative Iranian newspaper Jam-e Jam declared the election result "The twilight of Trump ism".

Why Europe's supermarket fridges were easy targets

FAST

BRUGES, Belgium, Nov 4 : Hackers who cranked up fridge temperatures at supermarkets across Europe may have gained access through public internet-connected systems protected by default passwords or outdated software, a cybersecurity expert said.
The second cyberattack in three weeks hit fridge systems at supermarket chains including Carrefour and Delhaize in Belgium, and ICA and Coop in Sweden, forcing retailers to discard spoiled food and raising concerns about food security. Three blood banks in France were also hit.
Authorities have not publicly disclosed how the attackers gained access, and no perpetrator has been identified.
Laurens Singier, an ethical hacker and researcher at Cyber 3 Lab, part of Howest University of Applied Sciences in Bruges, Belgium, said internet-connected systems which can be accessible remotely often have weak protections.

"In this case, the weak point was mainly putting those devices on the public internet. They shouldn't even be there," he said, speaking from a lab full of servers and systems similar to those that could control supermarket store fridges.
A common problem with such systems is that operators fail to change default passwords set by the manufacturer, while others run older software with known vulnerabilities, he said.
AI was now making it easier for amateurs to pull off hacks, Singier added.
Supermarkets on Tuesday said they had taken hacked fridges offline, in line with guidance from refrigeration monitoring software provider Danfoss, whose systems were again among those targeted. Danfoss has said it is working with clients on fixes.
Singier said that retailers should check they understand how they connect to the store interface, strengthen passwords, and consider switching from internet-based systems to more secure systems using SIM cards, like those used by solar panels and car chargers.
"After this attack, we've seen a lot less of these devices publicly on the internet," he said. "But if you look at the numbers, there's still a lot of industrial devices which are open to the public, and in a lot of cases you yourself as the butcher or the chocolatier don't even know about it."

Source: Reuters

items.title: ¿Por qué la derrota de Trump puede ser positiva para los mercados, según expertos?
items.author: Juan Pablo Álvarez
items.summary: El triunfo de los demócratas fue arrasador y distintas voces del sector financiero creen que el resultado va a tener una incidencia positiva en bonos y acciones.
items.body: Muchas veces, la derrota del candidato más volcado a la derecha puede ser tomada de mala manera por el mercado, pero en el caso de las elecciones de medio término en Estados Unidos hay quienes creen que el arrasador triunfo demócrata ayudará a las acciones y los bonos. Una de las personas que se manifestó en ese sentido fue Michael Strobaek, director global de Inversiones en Lombard Odier, quien declaró: “La trayectoria de los rendimientos de largo plazo apunta a la baja, y eso es una buena noticia para los inversores. Al fin y al cabo, lo que impulsó los rendimientos al alza fueron las promesas incumplidas en materia de inflación y el rumbo fiscal de Estados Unidos”. VER MÁS: Economistas elevan previsiones de tasas de interés e inflación en Brasil tras reelección de Lula Asimismo, el ejecutivo de Lombard Odier recordó que “los gobiernos divididos en Washington suelen ser positivos para los mercados de acciones”, ya que, según su óptica, los inversores “prefieren que existan controles y contrapesos en materia de políticas públicas”. Por su parte, George Saravelos, director global de Research sobre Divisas de Deutsche Bank, indicó que la derrota del Partido Republicano puede ser positiva para los activos de riesgo: “La combinación de una amplia mayoría demócrata en el Congreso y la declaración del presidente Donald Trump de que está dispuesto a trabajar con la oposición debería funcionar como un freno a los resultados más extremos en materia de políticas públicas y reducir las primas de riesgo”. Un informe que preparó la app de inversiones XTB sobre el desempeño histórico del mercado en torno a las elecciones de medio término reveló que: En tanto, un informe de Deutsche Bank resalta que “el mercado subió en casi todos los períodos de 12 meses posteriores a las elecciones de medio término”. Y destaca los siguientes aspectos:

items.title: S&P/TSX composite up nearly 500 points after Democrats take control of U.S. Congress
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s main stock index jumped nearly 500 points, while U.S. stock markets also shot higher in early trading after midterm elections in the United States.
items.body: TORONTO — Canada’s main stock index jumped nearly 500 points, while U.S. stock markets also shot higher in early trading after midterm elections in the United States saw the Democrats take control in both houses of Congress. The S&P/TSX composite index was up 480.11 points at 36,012.39. In New York, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 1,173.36 points at 52,960.08. The S&P 500 index was up 102.23 points at 7,671.15, while the Nasdaq composite was up 310.72 points at 25,682.73. The Canadian dollar traded for 71.68 cents US compared with 71.46 cents US on Tuesday. The December crude oil contract was down US$3.11 at US$92.98 per barrel. The December gold contract was up US$107.40 at US$4,047.80 an ounce. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 4, 2026.

PARIS, Nov 4 : World number one Alexander Zverev's reign at the top of the rankings got off to a disappointing start on Wednesday as Italy's Lorenzo Musetti upset the German top seed 7-6(5) 6-2 in the Paris Masters round of 32.
The 29-year-old, who climbed to number one on Monday, suffered surprise defeat days after losing to Australia's Alex de Minaur in the Vienna Open semi-finals.
Musetti, a former world number five, seized the initiative by winning six of the final seven points of the opening-set tiebreak before taking command of the second set.
The 24-year-old Italian broke Zverev for a 2-1 lead and struck again to move 5-2 ahead on his way to victory.

World number 24 Musetti, a former French Open and Wimbledon semi-finalist, fired 29 winners and eight aces during the one-hour, 40-mnute contest to improve his head-to-head record against Zverev to 4-2.
"It's pretty shocking the level I was able to play in front of Sascha, who was serving really well, especially in the first set," Musetti said.
"It was really close. It could have gone both ways."
The win continued a resurgence for Musetti, who has been hampered by injuries throughout the 2026 season. His toughest setback came at the Australian Open, where he retired while leading 24-times Grand Slam champion Novak Djokovic by two sets in their quarter-final.
Musetti ended a four-year wait for a title in Lyon last month.
Zverev has enjoyed a breakthrough season, capturing his maiden Grand Slam title at the French Open before adding a second major crown at the US Open.
He has secured his place at the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin this month.

Source: Reuters

PARIS, Nov 4 : Online fashion retailer Shein said on Wednesday it would invest €500 million ($562 million) to expand its European logistics hub in Poland as it pursues faster deliveries and greater operational flexibility.
Shein, along with Chinese competitors such as Temu and AliExpress, is adapting to charges imposed in July to curb what the EU says is unfair competition from online retailers. 
• The EU initially introduced a €3 fee for parcels worth less than €150, and increased the levy by €2 on November 1
• Shein's sales in Europe dropped sharply in the second quarter, contributing to a 67 per cent net profit fall

[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - 米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が４日発表した１０月の非製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は５４．５と、前月の５４．９から小幅に低下した。新規事業の勢いが鈍化した。一方、供給網の混乱は続き、投入価格は高止まりした。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は５４．８だった。

ＰＭＩは第４・四半期の米経済が堅調な滑り出しとなったことを示した。ただ、エコノミストは景気の減速を予想している。個人消費は２四半期続けて力強く伸びたが、今後は減速するとみられている。高インフレが家計の購買力を圧迫しており、消費を抑える一因になるとみられる。

１０月の新規事業指数は５５．９と、９月の５９．８から低下した。イラン戦争や輸入関税の影響で、供給業者の納入状況は一段と悪化した。

供給業者の納入状況を示す指数は５６．７と、９月の５３．２から大幅に上昇した。５０を上回ると納入の遅れを示す。納入の遅れは２３カ月連続となり、投入価格の高止まりにつながっている。

投入コストを示す支払価格指数は７３．０と、９月の７４．０から低下したものの、なお高水準だった。

雇用指数は５０．１から５１．４へ上昇した。

items.title: Binance heist puts focus on rising cyberattacks by nation-state actors
items.author: Shivani Shinde
items.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance heist has renewed concerns over nation-state cyberattacks and AI-driven vulnerabilities, putting the security preparedness of crypto exchanges under scrutiny ...
items.body: On October 29, the world’s largest crypto exchange, Binance, reported a security hack. Roughly $6.3 billion was drained from the exchange platform, more than four times the previous record. In February 2025, Bybit reported a heist of $1.5 billion. The incident once again brings into focus cyberattacks led by nation-state actors, as well as the rising incidence of such attacks due to the use of AI. In India, the Binance incident perhaps brought back memories of the WazirX security incident. In July 2024, the platform suffered a major cyberattack and lost about $235 million from a multi-signature wallet managed by Liminal Custody. While cyberattacks on crypto exchanges have increased in recent times, the Binance hack has had a severe impact. First, it is the largest heist so far. Second, considering that Binance is one of the largest players and a major liquidity provider for futures trading, particularly in India, the incident assumes significance. Third, users will evaluate platforms based on the wherewithal they have to deal with such hacks. The most significant step that Binance took was the way the company accepted accountability and assured users that their investments would not be impacted. This was done immediately, which perhaps is one of the reasons there has been no panic among users. Binance was quick to say in a post on X that it would absorb the financial impact of the stolen funds, not its users. “We have already set aside more than 100% of the funds required to cover the loss. As of October 31, 2026, 98% of the impacted token assets have been replenished and are verifiable on our Proof of Reserves page. We are in the process of purchasing the outstanding, more illiquid assets,” said the company. The company, in its latest comment, said: “We have taken immediate action to contain the incident and strengthen the systems involved. The entry points identified as having been used in the attack have been closed. Systems touched in the attack path have been rebuilt or replaced. We have also implemented tighter device controls, enhanced wallet-service risk controls and expanded AI-based behavioural anomaly detection.” Binance also said that the investigation highlighted that the attack was sophisticated and a multi-stage campaign. It was not a single, isolated breach or a simple phishing incident. The attackers combined a range of techniques, including social engineering through fake recruitment interviews, malicious software downloads, compromised internal AI tooling, endpoint compromise and an advanced transaction-authorisation method. The human factor More importantly, social engineering also played its role. This once again brings into focus the role of humans in such attacks. An investigation by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) linked the Binance hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor. When asked why nation-state actors have been successful in hacking systems even when they have strong key management systems, Jayant Dave, CISO, APAC, Check Point Software Technologies, who has tracked at least seven major crypto thefts since 2024, said that none had broken the cryptography. His findings were that five began with a staff member’s or supplier’s device, token or session. Four involved a supplier. In four cases, people approved the malicious transaction. “State-linked groups are patient and well-funded, and they go where the defence is thinnest. Strong key management makes the vault hard to crack. So they target what is allowed to ask the vault to open: an engineer’s laptop, a supplier’s tool, an approval screen. The FBI attributes Binance to North Korea’s TraderTraitor. US and Japanese authorities have warned for years about this group’s lures aimed at engineers,” he shared in an email response to Business Standard. In its post on the modus operandi, Binance said that social engineering was also part of the hack. The attackers used a fake job interview, an internal AI tool and a stolen deployment token to reach the internal wallet signing service and start transactions outside the normal withdrawal process. Saurabh Sharma, Lead Security Researcher at the Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT) at Kaspersky, agrees with the assessment of nation-state actors' operations. He said that in such cases, attackers rarely break the keys. “They target the people and systems that are already trusted to use those keys. That is why these groups focus on engineers, developers and executives,” he said. In 2025, Kaspersky researchers detailed how BlueNoroff, a Lazarus subgroup, used fake video calls and fake recruiters to compromise people working in the crypto industry. Even experienced specialists can be caught out, as in the case of a blockchain developer who lost $500,000 after installing a fake code editor extension. “Once inside a trusted device, attackers can work through the organisation’s own approval processes. Technology alone cannot stop that if one compromised system is allowed to carry too much authority,” he added. State-linked groups are known for this kind of patience. Kaspersky’s analysis of Lazarus’s Operation FlashHole found a campaign that had been active since at least July 2025, with tools reworked over time to make it more persistent. “For investigators, it also means the first compromised device is rarely the full story. Every access point has to be traced and closed before systems can be trusted again. Exact timelines, however, can only be confirmed once the investigation is complete,” said Sharma. Lessons for Indian players From a security perspective, experts say Indian exchanges are already a target. Sharma shared that the GhostCall and GhostHire campaigns uncovered by Kaspersky have targeted Web3 and cryptocurrency organisations in India since at least April 2025. “The priority should be to make sure no single compromise can move funds. Developer and DevOps machines should be kept separate from systems that approve withdrawals, with independent checks for high-value transfers. This matters because valid accounts and trusted relationships remain leading entry points in the attacks our teams investigate,” he said. Dave says that this is not just an India-specific issue; every market faces this challenge. “Rules and audits confirm the right controls exist. The attackers behind these thefts test whether those controls hold under pressure. They are patient, and they work through people, devices and suppliers. That calls for testing alongside compliance,” he added. Dave also feels that India has built one of the more structured frameworks in the region and that it continues to strengthen it. He points to the CERT-In’s 2022 directions, which require incidents to be reported within six hours and logs to be kept for 180 days. “Crypto service providers must keep KYC and transaction records for five years. FIU-IND registration brings exchanges into the anti-money-laundering framework. Its 2026 guidelines add a cyber security audit by a CERT-In-empanelled auditor. Fast reporting and good logs are exactly what investigators need after an incident like this,” he shared. Though security experts have laid out what needs to be done, it is ultimately up to the players to take security seriously. “At CoinSwitch, we follow a risk-based approach to managing wallet exposure and withdrawals, with a focus on minimising potential vulnerabilities. This includes limiting exposure to online wallets, implementing layered access controls, transaction monitoring and withdrawal safeguards,” said Balaji Srihari, VP, Business, India, CoinSwitch. “We also emphasise segregation of duties and restricted access to critical systems to reduce insider-related risks. These controls are periodically reviewed and tested through security assessments and audits, helping us strengthen our preparedness against evolving external threats as well as potential internal risks,” he added. Nischal Shetty, founder of WazirX, said that security cannot be treated as a one-time exercise or a box to be ticked. It needs to be an ongoing priority, embedded into the way businesses operate. “Cybersecurity is not a crypto-specific challenge; it is a financial ecosystem-wide concern. Traditional banking, fintech and cryptocurrency are all exposed to an increasingly sophisticated threat landscape. However, the scrutiny on the crypto industry is understandably higher, given the direct involvement of funds and the greater difficulty of recovering stolen assets compared to traditional banking. This makes security an especially critical responsibility for the industry,” he added. Shetty also said that with the rapid advancement of AI, the industry is seeing an expanding vulnerability landscape, with new risks emerging across the software libraries, operating systems, browsers and server infrastructure that underpin modern products. “This makes it increasingly important for companies to look beyond preventive security measures and have a plan in place for worst-case scenarios,” he added.

items.title: ネタニヤフ氏の政敵ら、首相抜きの政権樹立狙う　米議会での民主勝利受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steven Scheer　Alexander Cornwell

[エルサレム ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Steven Scheer　Alexander Cornwell

[エルサレム ４日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相の政敵らは、米民主党が議会を制したことは、同氏が米国による何世代にもわたるイスラエルに対する超党派的な支持を台無しにした証拠だとし、同氏抜きでの政権を樹立する機会をうかがっている。

３日投開票の米中間選挙では、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。不人気な対イラン戦争への強い不満や生活費高騰への不安、トランプ大統領の政権運営に対する怒りが背景にある。

米国は何世代にもわたり、両党の歴代大統領の下でイスラエルの最も強固な同盟国であり、１９７０年代以降は年間数十億ドルの軍事支援を提供してきた。だが、民主・共和両党に熱心に働きかけてきた歴代の指導者とは異なり、ネタニヤフ氏はあからさまに共和党を支持してきた。

民主党と一部の共和党の間でのイスラエル支持は、イスラエルが２０２３年のイスラム組織ハマスによる攻撃を受けてガザで軍事攻撃に乗り出した後に揺らぎ、今年に入ってトランプ氏とネタニヤフ氏がイランへの共同攻撃を命じて以来、その支持はさらに低下した。

イスラエルの中道左派野党「民主党」のヤイル・ゴラン党首はＸへの投稿で、米中間選挙の結果は「ネタニヤフ氏が民主・共和両党の間でいかに有害な存在かを浮き彫りにしている」と指摘した。 

中道野党イェシュアティドのラピド党首は、この結果は、ネタニヤフ氏が政権にとどまることを「イスラエルは許容できない」ことを示していると述べ、「それはわれわれの安全保障を脅かし、民主主義を危険にさらし、国際舞台でのわれわれの立場を損なうことになる」と強調した。

米中間選挙のわずか１週間前に実施されたイスラエル総選挙では、ネタニヤフ首相の陣営がユダヤ系国民から事前の予想を上回る支持を獲得し、同氏は少なくとも暫定首相として続投することがほぼ確実となった。ネタニヤフ氏の陣営は予想通り国会で過半数を失ったものの、野党勢力が同氏を退陣に追い込むには、アラブ系政党から何らかの支持を得ることが不可欠となった。   

ネタニヤフ氏はこれまでのところ、米選挙の結果について沈黙を保っている。同氏の事務所はコメント要請に応じなかった。

items.title: StatCan reports $5.4B merchandise trade surplus for September
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Statistics Canada says the country’s merchandise trade surplus increased to $5.4 billion in September as exports edged higher and imports decreased.
items.body: OTTAWA — Statistics Canada says the country’s merchandise trade surplus increased to $5.4 billion in September as exports edged higher and imports decreased. The agency says the result compared with a trade surplus of $5 billion in August. Total exports edged up 0.2 per cent in September to $78.6 billion, boosted by exports of crude oil and gold. Exports of energy products rose 8.2 per cent in September, helped by higher oil prices, while exports of metal and non-metallic mineral products, which includes unwrought gold, increased 8.6 per cent. Total imports fell 0.3 per cent in September to $73.2 billion as imports of motor vehicles and parts fell 9.1 per cent in the month. In volume terms, total exports fell four per cent, while imports fell 2.5 per cent. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 4, 2026.

［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ - 米中間選挙から一夜明けた４日の米国株式市場は、大幅高で寄り付いた。投資家は、中間選挙での民主党の圧勝で「ねじれ」状態となった議会では急激な政策転換が抑えられるとの見方を織り込んだ。

ただ、ＡＩ（人工知能）規制強化への懸念が重しとなり、データセンター関連株は売り圧力にさらされた。 

民主党は、ＡＩ業界の急拡大に対する住民の反発が強まっているテキサス州やジョージア州など、主要なデータセンター集積州で議席を伸ばした。

items.title: イラン、米中間選挙を「反戦の審判」と歓迎　警戒態勢は継続
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Parisa Hafezi

[４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Parisa Hafezi

[４日 ロイター] - イラン政府は、米中間選挙でトランプ大統領に下された手厳しい審判を歓迎し、有権者が同大統領の始めた戦争を拒絶したと宣言した。一方で、同国は攻撃が再開される可能性に備え、高度な警戒態勢を維持している。

イランの首席交渉官であるガリバフ国会議長はＸへの投稿で、「良心のためか生活費のためかはともかく、米国民は『戦争にノー』と言った。われわれはこのメッセージを支持する」と表明。米政府はイランを再び攻撃することで世論を無視すべきではないと述べた。

イランの最高指導者モジタバ師は文書による声明で、どの政党が政権を握ろうと米国の敵意は続くとし、米国への「わずかな服従の傾向さえ」示すことに警告を発した。その上で、「米国は自らの覇権の終わりを遠いものと見ているが、われわれは近いと見ている」と付け加えた。

イランの保守系紙ジャメジャムは、選挙結果を「トランプ主義の黄昏（たそがれ）」と評した。

３日投開票の米中間選挙では、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。共和党の地盤での民主党の勝利は、トランプ氏の経済運営や、ガソリン価格を押し上げた開戦の決断に対する深い不満を浮き彫りにした。

イランでは、司法府が運営する報道機関がＸ上で広まっているジョークを紹介。「トランプ氏はイランでの体制転換には失敗したが、テキサスでは成功した」というもので、南部テキサス州で数十年ぶりに民主党が上院選に勝利したことを指している。

ただ、イラン高官２人はロイターに対し、イランの指導部は民主党の勝利を歓迎しているものの、トランプ氏がその埋め合わせに軍事攻撃に踏み切る可能性をイランは懸念しており、高度な警戒態勢を続けていると語った。

選挙後にイラン戦争が再燃しかねないとの懸念の中、仲介役は紛争終結に向けた取り組みを強化している。しかしトランプ氏は３日、投票後の戦闘作戦再開の可能性を排除しなかった。イランも戦争が再開すれば、より広範な報復を計画している。

トランプ氏はＦＯＸニュースのインタビューで、中間選挙で共和党が敗北した一因がイラン戦争だったと認めた。

FAST

Nov 4 : Ireland flyhalf Sam Prendergast has been passed fit to play against Argentina in the Nations Championship in Dublin on Friday after recovering from a wrist injury. 
• Ireland coach Andy Farrell on Wednesday named six changes from the side beaten 40-21 by New Zealand in their last Nations Championship game, including a first test start for Sean Jansen at the back of the scrum.
• Craig Casey has been picked ahead of Jamison Gibson-Park at scrumhalf and Nick Timoney is preferred to Josh van der Flier on the flank.
• Ryan Baird, Mack Hansen and Andrew Porter, who all missed both the Six Nations and the three-match southern series of the Nations Championship, are back in the starting lineup against Argentina.

Troops deployed in Indonesia as president sacks aide accused of wiretapping

(Refiles to add dropped first name of former president in paragraph 7)

By Ananda Teresia and Stanley Widianto

JAKARTA, Nov 4 (Reuters) – Indonesia’s president sacked his chief of staff on Wednesday after his arrest in a wiretapping scandal that the government said pointed to treason, as the military said thousands of troops were being mobilised in the capital to boost security. 

Show Full Article

Listyo Sigit Prabowo, who was appointed chief of staff just a few weeks ago, was among three senior police officers detained on Tuesday accused of illegally tapping the phones of President Prabowo Subianto and unnamed journalists, politicians, government officials and business people since early 2025. 

The illegal wiretaps were carried out by “rogue individuals” whose actions indicated treason, presidential spokesperson Prasetyo Hadi said. 

“It also tends toward acts that endanger state interests and the safety of the nation’s leadership, including the safety of the head of state,” Hadi told reporters. 

Reuters could not immediately contact the three suspects or their lawyers.

The scandal comes as the president, a retired army general, faces pressure on multiple fronts, with widening public discontent about his big-spending populist policies and a slump in investor confidence over his administration’s handling of the $1.5 trillion G20 economy. 

Political intrigue has been growing in Indonesia in recent weeks amid a rift between Prabowo and his two-term predecessor and former backer Joko Widodo, who remains highly influential, despite stepping back from politics. 

Listyo, the former national police chief, was known as a loyalist of Widodo.  

MILITARY MOBILISED TO ‘SAFEGUARD AND PROTECT STABILITY’

Troops were deployed to Jakarta to “safeguard and protect the stability of Indonesia’s security,” navy spokesperson Tunggul said late on Wednesday.

The deployment was also related to upcoming training in areas near Jakarta, Tunggul, who goes by one name, added.

Soldiers on the capital’s streets are not uncommon in Indonesia, where the military has been regularly deployed ahead of anti-government protests.   

Elected president in 2024 by a big majority, former special forces commander Prabowo has seen his approval rating slide in his second year in office, with unease over food prices and his troubled free meals and village cooperatives programmes.  

His administration has also been under intense investor scrutiny this year, with ratings outlook cuts, concerns about policy unpredictability, and record stock market routs after warnings by global index provider MSCI of an equities market downgrade. 

Prabowo’s party Gerindra said it would hold talks with other political parties to discuss the wiretapping,  with its secretary-general Sugiono on Wednesday calling the scandal “insubordination” within the government.  

In a post on X on Wednesday, former President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono appealed to Prabowo to “restore civility to our politics”.  

MOTIVE FOR WIRETAPS UNCLEAR

The government has yet to determine the motive for the wiretapping, said Yusril Ihza Mahendra, Indonesia’s senior minister for legal affairs.

Police late on Tuesday said the suspects were being investigated for unauthorised wiretaps. The targets of the wiretaps were not disclosed.

Amnesty International in Indonesia urged authorities on Wednesday to reveal who the subjects of the wiretaps were and said the public had a right to know.

“If this scandal is allowed to continue unchecked, it could pave the way for a secret police apparatus used to tame the opposition,” it said. 

Sana Jaffrey, a state-building researcher at the Australian National University, said the troop deployment in Jakarta could signal concerns about tension between the military and police loyal to former chief Listyo. 

“If Prabowo increasingly sees threats to his personal security, then this could strengthen the case for relying more heavily on the military,” she said, adding that the immediate concern was the risk of unintended escalation.

(Reporting by Ananda Teresia, Stanley Widianto and Gayatri Suroyo; Writing by Martin Petty, Alexandra Hudson)

items.title: Déficit comercial de EE.UU. cae 0,7% en septiembre por mayores exportaciones de bienes
items.author: Jeffrey Sparshott
items.summary: El déficit comercial estadounidense cayó a US$105.000 millones, por debajo de los US$107.900 millones previstos por los economistas, mientras las importaciones de bienes de capital alcanzaron un récor ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El déficit comercial de Estados Unidos se redujo ligeramente en septiembre, ya que el valor de las exportaciones de bienes alcanzó su nivel más alto en cuatro meses. Según datos del Departamento de Comercio publicados el miércoles, el déficit comercial de bienes y servicios se redujo un 0,7% respecto al mes anterior, situándose en US$105.000 millones. Los economistas habían proyectado un déficit de US$107.900 millones, basándose en la estimación media de una encuesta de Bloomberg. Las cifras comerciales mensuales, que no están ajustadas a la inflación, han fluctuado debido a los aranceles estadounidenses, un aumento en los precios del petróleo provocado por la guerra, interrupciones en las cadenas de suministro y una creciente demanda de computadoras, semiconductores y otros componentes necesarios para construir más centros de datos. Ver más: El dólar registra su mayor caída en dos meses tras la victoria demócrata en EE.UU. El valor de las exportaciones aumentó un 1,9%, impulsado por el incremento de los envíos de bienes de capital. Las importaciones crecieron un 1,2%, también debido al fuerte aumento de los equipos empresariales. El valor de las importaciones de bienes de capital —categoría que incluye computadoras y accesorios, semiconductores y equipos de telecomunicaciones— aumentó en US$11.600 millones con respecto al mes anterior, alcanzando un nuevo récord. Las empresas estadounidenses están invirtiendo fuertemente en tecnología importada para potenciar su capacidad de inteligencia artificial. Al mismo tiempo, las importaciones de suministros industriales, que incluyen petróleo y productos derivados del petróleo, disminuyeron en US$3.700 millones con respecto al mes anterior. Según el informe, Estados Unidos importó menos barriles de petróleo crudo que el mes anterior. Las exportaciones de suministros industriales disminuyeron en US$1.000 millones. Las importaciones y exportaciones de oro no monetario, una categoría que ha mostrado volatilidad recientemente, también disminuyeron. Ver más: Del malestar económico al avance demócrata en bastiones republicanos: qué pasó en las elecciones de EE.UU. En términos ajustados a la inflación, el déficit comercial global de mercancías se amplió a US$119.500 millones en septiembre, el mayor desde marzo de 2025. Las exportaciones de servicios, categoría que incluye viajes, regalías y servicios financieros, alcanzaron un nuevo récord. Por países, el déficit comercial de mercancías de Estados Unidos con Canadá se redujo. Las empresas a ambos lados de la frontera aumentaron sus envíos este verano para adelantarse a los aranceles tras el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales. Los aranceles estadounidenses del 50% entraron en vigor el 22 de agosto sobre miles de millones de dólares en productos canadienses; Canadá respondió con sus propios aranceles. Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 4 : Prediction markets got the big picture right in the US midterm elections, although a few races delivered surprises as Democrats seized control of the Senate and House of Representatives.
With more than $1.48 billion wagered on Tuesday's elections, the results offered a test of whether prediction markets could translate their odds into accurate electoral forecasts.
Bets placed on a Democratic midterm sweep largely paid off despite some mispriced races, as tens of millions of voters delivered a stinging rebuke to US President Donald Trump.
"Prediction markets priced the midterm outcome within hours," said Kelly Ye, head of research at digital asset trading platform Talos.

Several closely contested Senate races had attracted millions of dollars in bets, putting prediction markets under scrutiny. In many cases, the results tracked expectations, with Democrats winning Senate seats in Texas and Ohio.
"This was the first true prediction markets election," said Harry Crane, professor of statistics at Rutgers University.
"The markets projected Democratic wins across the board throughout the closing weeks of the campaign, and were quick to react in real time to voting information as it rolled in," he added.
Prediction markets rose to prominence as they diverged from traditional opinion polls by signaling a Trump victory in 2024, and analysts were scrutinizing their performance this week.
While the markets cite high accuracy rates in their betting odds, some high-profile misses during the US primaries and in Brazil's presidential election have shown they are fallible.
Prediction markets allow users to buy and sell contracts tied to real-world events, with prices reflecting traders' collective expectations. Critics, however, say those odds can be skewed by speculation, thin liquidity and concentrated bets.
Kalshi's total trading volume on election markets reached over $2.5 billion this cycle, compared with $1.3 billion during the 2024 election cycle, which included the presidential race.
Traders on Kalshi were assigning a 55 per cent probability to a "blue tsunami" as early as April. Meanwhile, Polymarket's election forecasts were about 98 per cent accurate, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters.
One notable miss came in conservative South Carolina, where Democrat Annie Andrews defeated Republican Darline Graham to win a Senate seat, defying market expectations.
Kalshi and Polymarket had implied a 70 per cent chance of Graham, the sister of the late US Senator Lindsey Graham, winning that race as of late afternoon Tuesday.
"Prediction markets can be useful because they aggregate the views of people who have an incentive to be right, not just to express an opinion," said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management.
"They can give a good indication of where the weight of information is pointing, but a prediction isn't a promise. Whether it’s politics or sports, you still have to hold the election or play the game to know the result," he added.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 4 : Data-center developer TeraWulf said on Wednesday it has secured a credit backstop agreement with Alphabet's Google to support financing needs for its data-center project with Claude creator Anthropic.
The company also announced an expanded agreement with construction and engineering firm Fluor Enterprises for the development of the data-center site in Hawesville, Kentucky.

FAST

PARIS, Nov 4 : French cooperative bank Credit Mutuel Arkea said on Wednesday it had been hit by a cyberattack which "enabled fraudulent transactions to be carried out" but that clients' money was not affected.
The bank said in a statement that the amount of money affected by the attack is still being assessed but is "not of a nature to undermine the Group’s financial strength and soundness." It did not give further details about the fraudulent transactions.
The incident has been contained, operations are resuming, and client assets are not affected, Credit Mutuel Arkea said. The group told the relevant authorities as soon as the attack was detected, it added.
Credit Mutuel Arkea is made up of Credit Mutuel's federations in Brittany and the southwest of France, as well as affiliated local banks and about 40 subsidiaries. The bank has 5.8 million clients and €211.5 billion ($237.51 billion) in assets, making it a major French financial firm, although significantly smaller than the likes of BNP Paribas and Societe Generale.

Nov 4 : The International Ice Hockey Federation said on Wednesday it maintains its disagreement with a Court of Arbitration for Sport decision to reinstate Russian teams, warning of "significant practical and sporting challenges".
The statement follows announcements from Norway, Denmark, Sweden and the Czech Republic that their national teams will refuse to play against Russia at next year's men's World Championships in Germany.
The CAS ruled last week to overturn the governing body's exclusion of Russia from international competition following its 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
"As presented to the CAS, the immediate reintegration of Russian teams presents significant practical and sporting challenges, including visa and entry requirements, security provisions, logistical constraints and consequences for competition formats," the IIHF said.

LONDON, Nov 4 : British culture minister Lisa Nandy formally intervened in Sky's proposed acquisition of ITV's broadcast business on Wednesday, saying she had asked the Competition and Markets Authority and Ofcom to provide reports on the impact of the deal by January 27.
Nandy said last month she was minded to intervene in the £1.6 billion ($2.15 billion) deal, citing concerns about its potential impact on news plurality, Sky's influence over the media landscape and the availability of a broad range of programming.

PARIS, Nov 4 : Arthur Fils sealed his first qualification for the season-ending ATP Finals on Wednesday, thanks to compatriot Quentin Halys' 6-3 1-6 7-6(9) victory over American Frances Tiafoe in the Paris Masters second round.

• Jannik Sinner has also qualified but will not compete due to injury, leaving two places still available.

FAST

Nov 4 : Qualcomm has signed a multi-year agreement with SpaceX to supply radio equipment, baseband units and software for Starlink Mobile's planned nationwide terrestrial 5G network, as the Elon Musk-led space company seeks to challenge established US wireless carriers.
The equipment will be deployed across tens of thousands of macro cell sites in the country starting in 2027, Qualcomm said on Wednesday. While the company did not disclose the financial terms of the agreement, it said "this is our biggest 5G deal yet."
The deal will expand the presence of Qualcomm, best known for the chips that power smartphones, in the telecom infrastructure market, where it will compete with Marvell, Broadcom and Intel by supplying chips used in cell tower gear.
Qualcomm, which has been seeking to diversify beyond mobile devices, already helps power 5G networks in Japan and Vietnam.

SpaceX aims to establish a major nationwide US wireless carrier, taking on incumbents AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile through a combination of satellite connectivity and terrestrial network.
Although questions remain about the feasibility of SpaceX's plans, given the substantial investment required to compete with the Big Three, the company has been moving ahead with spectrum acquisitions and exploring deals with cell tower firms to expand its terrestrial network.
Qualcomm said the equipment would provide a flexible foundation for a multi-band network, which can be deployed in stages. The initial rollout will focus on terrestrial 5G, with the architecture designed to accommodate developments in connectivity and network intelligence.
The company's radio technology is designed to improve coverage, capacity and spectral efficiency, or the amount of data that can be transmitted over a given amount of spectrum. Advanced beamforming technology will help direct wireless signals toward users, allowing SpaceX to make more efficient use of its licensed spectrum.

FAST

BENGALURU, Nov 4 - India's cybercrime agency has warned banks, non-bank lenders and other financial firms of cyberattacks carried out with the help of artificial intelligence agents, amid a surge in incidents targeting the sector.
"These attacks are financially motivated and are being carried out with the help of Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents leading to machine speed compromise," the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) said in an advisory made public on Wednesday. 
The warning comes at a time when regulators around the world, including those in the US and Britain, are stepping up efforts to contain AI risks.
Last month, AI models under test broke into Indian organisations' live systems and read confidential records undetected, in the country's first such official account after similar incidents of rogue AI behaviour worldwide.

India has also seen a surge in cyber incidents in recent weeks. Data of 3,900 customers was leaked at State Bank of India, the country's largest lender.
The Reserve Bank of India has also warned banks of rising cyberattacks on financial infrastructure, seeking proof of compliance with existing rules and details of their preparedness for AI-related risks, Reuters reported last week.
The cybercrime agency said hackers exploit unpatched software or misconfigured IT systems to compromise infrastructure, then target automated fund disbursement systems or application programming interfaces (APIs) used for payments and fund transfers.
The use of an agentic AI framework makes it possible to carry out such attacks at machine speed, it added.
The I4C asked all financial entities, including banks, fintech firms and payment aggregators, to implement measures outlined by CERT-In, the government's cybersecurity agency, on October 9.
It also suggested additional safeguards, such as setting daily and per-transaction limits, verifying beneficiary names and watching for unusual transaction speeds. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: Delhi Chokes on ‘Very Poor’ Air After Cleanest October in Years
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: Thick smog cloaked Delhi Wednesday as the national capital’s winter pollution worsened a week ahead of the Diwali festival, when firecrackers typically intensify the haze.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- Thick smog cloaked Delhi Wednesday as the national capital’s winter pollution worsened a week ahead of the Diwali festival, when firecrackers typically intensify the haze.The citywide air quality index reached 379 at 10 a.m., near the top end of what India describes as “very poor,” according to the Central Pollution Control Board data. The average concentration of fine particulate matter that can penetrate lungs and enter the bloodstream reached 277, more than 18 times the 24-hour level recommended by the World Health Organization.The deterioration marks a reversal from an AQI of 166 last month — the cleanest October in eight years — as unusually heavy rain washed away pollutants and favorable airflow helped disperse emissions. Every winter, falling temperatures and weak winds trap emissions from vehicles, industry, construction, waste burning and farm fires over Delhi, turning the capital’s air toxic for weeks. The recurring crisis forces schools and businesses to adjust operations, strains public health and erodes productivity across one of the world’s largest urban economies. Authorities tried to get ahead of the problem this year with a formal calendar of restrictions. The latest measures that took effect Nov. 1 bar older commercial vehicles and dust-emitting construction, limit people working from offices and double parking charges. The regional air-quality regulator also rolled out similar emergency restrictions.“But having a plan alone doesn’t ensure clean air. The implementation is still not up to the mark,” said Sunil Dahiya, founder and lead analyst at climate research firm Envirocatalysts. The measures don’t cover the larger area around the capital that contributes to emissions, while crop burning is adding to an “already elevated pollution load,” he said.Delhi’s microscopic pollutants that have been linked to cancer come from a mix of local and regional sources. Secondary particles — chemicals formed as emissions from all sources blend — account for the biggest 27% share every winter, according to India’s Environment Ministry. Transport is the next top source, followed by burning of biomass including crops in surrounding areas.Crop fires in the nearby states of Punjab and Haryana have fallen by more than 90% since 2021, according to federal government data. Still, an Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology model forecasts their contribution to pollution rising from less than 9% on Nov. 2 to more than 20% by Nov. 5. But environmentalists say the capital’s air remains relatively unhealthy for much of the year.“Authorities are still treating Delhi’s pollution as an episodic event, and not a yearlong problem,” said Manoj Kumar, an analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. “Concern spikes when air turns severe and visibility falls. But less attention is given to why Delhi has recorded only one ‘good’ air day in 2026.”More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

FAST

Nov 4 : The rise of AI-led shopping is posing a conundrum for retailers like Walmart and Amazon: how to enable AI agents to shop on their websites, without threatening their lucrative advertising revenue and the customer data that fuels it.
Retail powerhouses Walmart and Amazon are also the world's two largest retail media businesses, dominating the estimated $74.4 billion in US retail media spending with a combined 88 per cent share of that market, according to projections from data firm Emarketer. But digital assistants could soon disrupt that business.
AI-powered agents that can research and purchase products on consumers' behalf — like Meta's recently released Muse — could erode the highly profitable business of brands paying retailers to promote products on their websites and apps. Morgan Stanley researchers said in July these agents could account for 10 per cent to 20 per cent of US e-commerce spending by 2030.
Amazon and Walmart are taking different approaches to agentic AI shopping. Amazon has blocked Muse, while Walmart is officially partnering with Meta's agentic tool.

So far, there is no meaningful effect yet on Amazon ads from third-party agents, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said last week. However, the company's 11 per cent year-over-year growth in advertising revenue for the third quarter was its slowest pace of growth in nearly four years, LSEG data show. The segment consistently accounts for about 10 per cent of total net sales.
DIFFERENT APPROACHES
Amazon banned Muse from its website in September, saying it appeared to have accessed its online store without authorization, capturing and storing customer credentials. Meta declined to comment.
The e-commerce leader told Reuters this week that third-party agents should operate openly and respect service providers' decisions about whether or not to participate.
Amazon also won a court order blocking Perplexity's shopping agent Comet in March, though the 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals overturned the ban in August, a decision Amazon said it disagreed with. The case is ongoing.
Walmart, conversely, rolled out infrastructure on October 21 to enable third-party agentic commerce. When a shopper uses an agent to browse, Walmart will create a profile for that agent that links to the shopper's Walmart account. Consumers can approve purchases or set spending limits.
Walmart CFO John David Rainey told analysts and investors in August that advertising, which includes the Walmart Connect retail media business, along with its membership and marketplace operations, accounted for 45 per cent of quarterly operating income growth. Walmart does not separately break out Walmart Connect's figures in its earnings release.
Dan Marc, CEO of retail media platform Footprints AI, said he expects companies like Amazon and Walmart to start signing their largest advertisers to multiyear ad deals to secure those revenues, and also expects more discounts on digital retail media ads as shoppers turn to large language models and agentic tools.
Walmart declined to comment.
SHIFTING MARKETING LANDSCAPE
Morningstar analyst Brett Husslein said the moment presents "an evolution rather than an existential threat" for retail media. Brands are expected to spend 22.6 per cent more on retail media in 2026 than last year's $60.7 billion, Emarketer forecasts show.
This year, Walmart started testing ads within Sparky, its AI shopping chatbot, just as Amazon has embedded them in its AI shopping assistant, Alexa for Shopping.
Advertising for bots may rely less on visual flair or emotional resonance and more on specific product data that matches customer queries using AI chatbots, industry practitioners and consultants say.
Companies including Procter & Gamble, Nestle and L'Oreal have said they are trying to make product information digestible for AI agents. Those agents are bringing brands closer to consumers, said Mondelez's vice president of global digital commerce, Andrew Lederman, on a podcast in April. He said retailer media sites currently still drive the vast majority of volume for the company.
"We are not recommending that clients fundamentally shift their retail media budgets overnight," said Amie Owen, chief client officer at digital commerce consultancy Flywheel. "But we are advising them to prepare for how discovery and purchase decisions may evolve."
Katherine Black, a senior consultant at Kearney, envisions a radical shift, in which retail media eventually evolves into a kind of "bidding system" where agents search for a product at a consumer’s price point, and retailers set price ceilings and floors.
"All retailers need to be thinking about how to interact with consumers in new ways," Black said.

Source: Reuters

BERLIN, Nov 4 : Heidenheim's Frank Schmidt, Germany's longest serving coach in professional football history, will leave the club after almost 20 years at the end of the season, the second division team said on Wednesday.
Schmidt, 52, took over in September 2007 when they were in the fourth tier, and in 2023 surpassed the previous record of 16 years for the longest serving pro coach in Germany.
"It was truly impressive to see how much effort the club put into securing another contract extension with me," Schmidt said in a statement.
"However, in recent weeks, I have come to the conclusion that it is time to make a decision. After nearly 20 years as head coach at FCH, I simply want to take a break this summer.
